label: common_0100_rival_01
text: All right! This here is Poco Path![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_11
text:
It’s the path that leads to adventure for you
and me!\c
Out here, things are different than in town.
You’re gonna see wild Pokémon out and about.
They’ll be on the path and in the grass and such![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_12
text: Get too close to one, and you’ll have to battle.\nBut you’ve got [VAR 0x0101(0001)] for that, right?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_13

label: common_0100_rival_20a
text: Nice! Defeating Pokémon in battle will help\n[VAR 0x0101(0001)] grow and get stronger![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_21a
text: Next time, try throwing a Poké Ball when a\nPokémon’s riiight on the tip of being defeated.\r\nYou’ll have a decent chance at catching it then![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_20b
text: Good call! If you know you can’t win a battle,\ntactical retreats are what’s up![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_21b
text: When you’ve got the edge, though, you can try\ncatching the wild Pokémon in a Poké Ball![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_20c
text: Hala! That was awesome! You caught the very\nfirst Pokémon you went for![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_21c
text: I’m crummy when it comes to actually catching\nPokémon. Maybe YOU should give ME tips![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_20d
text: Aw, you lost! Were you hesitating a little when it\ncame time to attack?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_21d
text: Sometimes seeing how strong you are will make\nwild Pokémon accept you. So don’t be shy—\r\nbattle hard and throw those Poké Balls![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_07
text: Anyway, have some more Poké Balls just in case.\nNot every catch works out![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_08
text: Weaken the Pokémon, then throw the Poké Ball!\nRemember that, and you’ll be fine![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_09
text: Now go battle those wild Pokémon and catch\nsome of ’em![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_14
text: Let’s meet back up at that lighthouse over there!\nYou can see our school from the top![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_10
text: If your Pokémon are getting tired out, I can heal\n’em for ya![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0100_rival_15
text: Oh, and if you get real good at catching\nPokémon, gimme some advice! I’m not great at\r\nthe actual “throw the Poké Ball” part.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
